hooks.name: Keep tasks.md in sync on lib changes
hooks.description: When a lib/ file changes, remind the agent to update the spec tasks.md.

action.prompt: A lib/ file changed. Review .kiro/specs/spec-bundle-export/tasks.md and mark any task that is now fully implemented as done ([x]). If a new task is needed, add it. Keep edits minimal and do not change requirements.
